question.en: A class for describing a mobile phone SIM card is shown (attributes PIN, PUK, phonebook, messages; methods insertPIN, insertPUK, unlock, block, call, sendMessage). If you enter a wrong PIN three times, then you must enter a PUK code. If the PUK code is wrong, the SIM card is blocked. Draw a state diagram for the states of an object from the SIM card class.

question.en: Model a state diagram which describes the operation of a plane. When a new plane is bought, an object that represents that plane is created and its initial state is free. From this state, the plane can go to the taking-off or testing state. After the testing, it may be free again or declared incapable of driving. From the flight state, the plane can only go to the landing state, from which it can go in testing or taking off state.

question.en: Model a state diagram that describes the states of a course in a private school. Once the course is open, students who want to enroll in this course can register. There is a limit for the maximum number of students who can enroll in the course. If the limit is reached, students who want to register are added to the waiting list until a place is released. A place for a student is released if another student withdraws from the course.
